name: Necklace of Prayer Beads

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Cleric, Druid, or Paladin

summary: 1d4 + 2 magic beads, each casting a spell once a day as a Bonus Action (Bless, Cure Wounds, Greater Restoration...).
text: This necklace has 1d4 + 2 magic beads made from aquamarine, black pearl or topaz. It also has many nonmagical beads made from stones such as amber, bloodstone, citrine, coral, jade, pearl or quartz. If a magic bead is removed from the necklace, that bead loses its magic. Six types of magic beads exist; each bead's type is determined randomly. A necklace can have more than one bead of the same type. To use one, you must be wearing the necklace. Each bead contains a spell that you can cast from it as a Bonus Action (using your spell save DC if a save is necessary). Once a magic bead's spell is cast, that bead can't be used again until the next dawn. Blessing: Bless. Curing: Cure Wounds (level 2 version) or Lesser Restoration. Favor: Greater Restoration. Smiting: Shining Smite. Summons: Planar Ally. Wind Walking: Wind Walk.
